title: Invariant for the Empty Gate List
statement: For every natural number $n$, the empty gate list, identity tap map, and counter $n$ satisfy the construction invariant: the counter equals $n$, the constructed gate list is acyclic, taps on vertices below $n$ are below $n$ and injective, and every tapped vertex has the same value as the corresponding vertex of the empty computation for every Boolean input. Each vertex has fanout at most two, each tapped vertex has fanout zero, all constructed gates satisfy the required distinct-input and arity conditions, and the number of constructed gates is at most zero.
